h1: 3D visualization of a private house facade and yard landscaping

blocks.text: 3D visualization of a private house facade and yard landscaping

parts.html: Imagine what your future home and its grounds will look like before construction even begins. DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) creates photorealistic 3D visualizations of private house facades and their surroundings, allowing you to assess the building’s architecture and the overall site concept in advance.

The visualization can show the house facade, finishing materials and their combinations, color schemes, windows and doors, outdoor lighting, paths, terraces, and relaxation areas, as well as landscaping elements — trees, shrubs, lawns, and ornamental plants.

Combining the architecture of the house and the surrounding landscape in a single 3D visualization lets you see the property as a unified composition and assess how harmoniously the facade blends with the landscaping of the grounds.

Special attention is paid to the realistic rendering of materials and textures, natural light, shadows, vegetation, and details of the surroundings. As a result, the visualization shows the future appearance of the house and yard as clearly as possible.
3D visualization helps you compare different architectural and color solutions, choose materials, and make any necessary changes before construction and finishing work begins.
This type of visualization is ideal for presenting a project, approving architectural decisions, and gaining a clearer understanding of the final result at the design stage.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN creates professional 3D visualizations of private house facades and the surrounding grounds for projects in Slovakia and other European countries.
